title: reminder
content: In this synthetic example, the life-insurance premium is one thousand five hundred Philippine pesos, due on October fifteenth, two thousand twenty-six. This is not a real account or payment request.

title: premium
content: A premium is the amount paid for the policy. This demo cannot verify a payment, renew a policy, or promise that coverage continues.

title: policy
content: A policy is the insurance contract. Actual terms must be checked in the verified policy document with an authorized representative.

title: beneficiary
content: A beneficiary is the person designated to receive benefits under the policy terms. Changes require an authorized representative; this demo cannot change a beneficiary.

title: rider
content: A rider is an optional addition to a policy. Whether a particular rider is available or covers a condition must be verified; this demo cannot confirm benefits.

title: lapse
content: Lapse means that a policy may no longer be active under its terms. This demo cannot determine policy status, grace periods, or reinstatement eligibility.

title: coverage
content: Coverage describes the protection provided under the policy terms. Specific benefits and exclusions require verified policy documents and a representative.

title: bank referral
content: A bank referral directs you to an authorized insurance representative. A referral is not a guarantee of coverage or a request to share bank credentials.
